name: PCS Technology Limited
about: PCS Technology Limited provides information technology related facility management services in India. The company offers software development, implementation, and other related services. It also provides governance and risk consultancy, including information security consulting, risk assessment for information security, business continuity/ disaster recovery planning, ITSM implementation, information security testing, information security audits, IT service management consultancy, and ITSM/InfoSec training services; healthcare software solutions; audio video solutions and integration; IT service management; real time vehicle tracking solutions; application development services; and staffing solutions. In addition, the company is involved in the licensing and sale of software and ancillary products; business process services; and maintenance of equipment. The company serves capital markets and banking, manufacturing, retail, ITES and BPO, logistics and transportation, insurance, communication and media, government, energy and utilities, and healthcare sectors. PCS Technology Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Pune, India.
